scope: Auto resolution persistence, late Fusion metadata enrichment, and shared activity summaries; not the separate Fusion picker redesign.

eventOrderCoverage: phase and completion before route and turn-start, for Single/Cascade/Critique
late plan preserves completion status, final source and timestamps
late start enriches phase facts without resurrecting terminal work
duplicate completion preserves enriched phase facts
cold replay retains stable Auto item identity without chronological run guessing
private drafts and classifier payloads excluded

liveOrdinaryAutoDemo.workspace: Disposable repository containing only a harmless sum function.
liveOrdinaryAutoDemo.association: Resolution has no semantic turn ID; the UI explicitly preserves this telemetry gap.
liveOrdinaryAutoDemo.evidenceLocation: Maintainer session artifacts, not committed screenshot assets.
liveOrdinaryAutoDemo.limitation: Real ordinary Auto inference, not Fusion Standard or explicit Fusion tier qualification.

discovery.nativeInteractiveDiagnostic: Inconclusive; no picker observation establishes an account/runtime limitation.

surfaces.web: Live isolated browser pass and reload.
surfaces.desktop: Consumes the same web/shared presentation; no packaged desktop claim.
surfaces.mobile: Consumes shared summary/detail helpers; no new native device pass in this correction.
surfaces.entryPoints: No model-selection action or keybinding changed; existing activity details use shared formatting.
surfaces.reverseStates: Terminal outcomes remain terminal when start/plan telemetry arrives late.
surfaces.connectionModes: No origins or transport paths changed; metadata uses existing persisted contracts.

remainingGates: SDK-advertised selectable tier IDs and real per-tier execution.
